definitions.explanation: The area surrounding or near something.
Related or supplementary items; the outer edges.

examples.japanese: オリンピック{期間|きかん}{中|ちゅう}は、{会場|かいじょう}{周辺|しゅうへん}の{警備|けいび}が{強化|きょうか}された。
examples.english: Security around the venue was strengthened during the Olympics.

examples.japanese: {駅|えき}{周辺|しゅうへん}には{店|みせ}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: There are many shops in the area around the station.

examples.japanese: {周辺|しゅうへん}{機器|きき}を{買|か}い{揃|そろ}えた。
examples.english: I bought all the peripheral devices.

notes:
{周辺|しゅうへん} refers to the surrounding area or periphery.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～{周辺|しゅうへん}: the area around ~
- {周辺|しゅうへん}に: in the vicinity
- {周辺|しゅうへん}の: surrounding ~

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {駅|えき}{周辺|しゅうへん}: station area/vicinity
- {会場|かいじょう}{周辺|しゅうへん}: venue surroundings
- {周辺|しゅうへん}{地域|ちいき}: surrounding area
- {周辺|しゅうへん}{国|こく}: neighboring countries

Computing:
- {周辺|しゅうへん}{機器|きき}: peripheral devices
- {周辺|しゅうへん}装置: peripheral equipment

RELATED:
- {周囲|しゅうい}: surroundings, circumference
- {近辺|きんぺん}: vicinity
- {付近|ふきん}: neighborhood, vicinity
